## Activity

During November 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 393 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance. The site’s activity was recorded as part of routine operational monitoring.

## Image quality

There were 15 ungradable captures during the month. The ungradable rate was 3.8 per cent. This measure records the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and is reviewed alongside total activity. The result should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance and local review of image-taking practice.

## Grading

Grading identified 89 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This indicates the typical time between completion of imaging and the grading outcome. Results are presented for site-level operational oversight and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality measures. No new equipment faults were raised during the month.
